role.zh: 研究组发起人 · 博士

bio.en: Siyuan (Max) Meng earned his Ph.D. in Civil Engineering (Transportation Engineering) from the University of Massachusetts Amherst in September 2026, following B.S. and M.S. degrees from Chang’an University. His doctoral research connects roadside multi-LiDAR background modeling, unsupervised 3D detection, robust multi-point tracking, and quality-aware traffic conflict analysis. Building on this work, he explores infrastructure-centric world models and transportation system optimization under uncertainty, including EV routing and charging and infrastructure asset management.
bio.zh: 蒙思源于 2026 年 9 月获得麻省大学阿默斯特分校 (UMass Amherst) 土木工程博士学位（交通运输工程方向），本科与硕士毕业于长安大学。博士研究围绕质量感知的路侧多 LiDAR 交通感知与安全分析，涵盖背景建模、无监督三维目标检测、鲁棒多点跟踪与交通冲突分析。在此基础上，进一步探索以基础设施为中心的世界模型（I-WM）及不确定性条件下的交通系统优化，包括电动汽车路径与充电调度、基础设施资产管理。

affiliation.en: Assistant Professor, School of Automotive and Transportation Engineering, Wuhan University of Science and Technology.
affiliation.zh: 武汉科技大学汽车与交通工程学院，特聘副教授（青年百人）。
